decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel draws directly on the firm's core cryptography and authentication knowledge and supports its strategy of binding mobile communication, so its own R&D can keep improving it.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is the conceptual backbone of the integrated offering and the firm can interpret and refine it best with its deep security know-how.

The email-to-app delivery robot uses the firm's secure messaging competence, but its niche use case and weak market signals make it a likely candidate to be folded into broader messaging offerings, though it still fits the binding-communication direction.

The QR-based hardware token builds on the firm's hardware and authentication experience and serves high-assurance customers, but the shift toward app-based authentication raises the risk that it is phased out.

The payment network compliance suite relies on the firm's cryptography and regulatory know-how amid ongoing demand from PSD2 and similar rules, though its compliance-specific scope may lead to repackaging.
